affiliations.research_notes: The registrar finding aid and contemporary alumni list establish Dartmouth student status and class year. Dartmouth is not classified as an employer, and the sources do not prove it was the immediate pre-OSS status.

claims.claim_text: A contemporary Dartmouth alumni list identifies George Brickelmaier Jr., class of 1942, in OSS war work; the rare exact name and OSS context strongly match the indexed George Brickelmaier.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Dartmouth's February 1943 list places George Brickelmaier Jr., class of 1942, in full-time OSS war work.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare exact name, contemporary institutional OSS listing, matching registrar folder, and the OSS index. The index omits the suffix, which remains a documented variant rather than an overwritten spelling.
claims.temporal_assessment: The institutional list is dated February 1943 and identifies current full-time war work; it confirms OSS association but does not establish a predecessor employer.
claims.match_notes: No service identifier is available for a direct official-file match. Box 79 remains the route for confirmation and predecessor research.

claims.claim_text: George Brickelmaier Jr. was a Dartmouth College student in the class of 1942; the reviewed sources do not establish employment by Dartmouth or prove this was his immediate pre-OSS status.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Dartmouth's registrar finding aid places George Brickelmaier Jr. in the 1938-1942 class-of-1942 records, and the 1943 alumni list repeats his class year.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The rare exact name and suffix agree across two Dartmouth institutional sources, while the contemporary alumni list independently supplies OSS context.
claims.temporal_assessment: The 1938-1942 date span is pre-OSS and supports student status only; no immediate-predecessor sequence is asserted.
claims.match_notes: Dartmouth is excluded from employer analytics for this claim. No named civilian employer has been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Robert D. Brewster has a printed private identifier, but it produced no exact match in the official enlisted Army merged file. Robert Dows Brewster is a plausible namesake only; accessible sources do not connect him to OSS or Box 79.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 79 to resolve the identity and determine whether the Robert Dows Brewster candidate should be reconsidered. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.
